mechanism_narrative: A sustained recovery in TRANSIT from its trough signals restored commuting and out-of-home routines that lift retail footfall, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT fell to -40.4 at t-1w then improved to -38.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT continues to improve but RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days, the mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility crossing above -25 for two consecutive weeks indicates outdoor social activity has resumed enough to support adjacent retail trips, raising RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -25 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS was -12.1 at t-2w and -20.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS stays above -25 for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than the prior 28 days, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: High RESIDENTIAL mobility combined with negative GROCERY_PHARM signals precautionary at-home consumption, diverting trips away from retail and lowering RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL was +11.7 and GROCERY_PHARM was -8.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL remains above +10 and GROCERY_PHARM remains negative but RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days, the mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Under curfew and tightened capacity rules, WORKPLACES below -30 keeps office commuting suppressed, removing weekday retail demand and pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES was -34.0 at t-1w and -30.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES remains below -30 while RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT falling below -40 captures a new collapse in movement that precedes a drop in retail visits, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next week.
failure_condition: If TRANSIT falls below -40 but RETAIL_REC over the following 7 days is higher than its prior 7-day mean, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Joint recovery in PARKS and TRANSIT indicates broader reopening of daily routines; their interaction raises retail trips more than either alone, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved from -26.0 to -20.0 and TRANSIT from -40.4 to -38.7 between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: If both PARKS and TRANSIT improve together but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than the prior 28 days, the interaction mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in RESIDENTIAL mobility from its elevated level indicates reduced stay-at-home behavior, freeing households to visit retail venues and raising RETAIL_REC over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL was +13.0 at t-1w and +11.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL falls below +12 but RETAIL_REC over the following 7 days is not higher than its prior 7-day mean, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: The approach of the December holiday shopping season raises retail activity independently of mobility, so RETAIL_REC increases over the next four weeks even if transit and workplaces stay depressed.
evidence_refs: fact:Decision date 2020-11-15 is six weeks before Christmas
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days despite the holiday season, the seasonal mechanism is rejected.
